exposure: gestational age at time of cesarean delivery
cohort: The study included 468 term singleton cesarean deliveries for breech presentation performed at a tertiary medical center between February 2020 and January 2022.
finding: Cesarean deliveries performed between 39+0 and 39+6 weeks of gestation for breech presentation were associated with better maternal outcomes and lower rates of emergent cesarean deliveries compared to deliveries at earlier or later gestations.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries performed at 39+0 to 39+6 weeks for breech presentation resulted in better maternal outcomes and fewer emergent cesarean deliveries.
gest_age: term (>=37+0 weeks), specifically studied at 37+0 to 38+6 weeks, 39+0 to 39+6 weeks, and >=40 weeks
